note: The journal's web of what needs what (J2a, docs 13, 15), drawn as a trail, a focus card and a shelf (src/ui/journal-web.js): no layout lives here, so adding a species or a ground feature is one node and its links. kinds: the shelf's tabs in order, each with its label and drawn icon (src/ui/icons); every node names one, and its tint comes from journal.css (--jw-<kind>-*). nodes, in shelf order: label, kind, icon, and what makes the node known: page (a journal page id; known once that page is known, or for a Ground page once that ground is on the island), on (one or more keys of the island's presence: ground pages, shore zone ids from shore.json, pool for rock pools, strandline; known while any is on the island), flag (a journal flag) or always (known from the start, as you are). A node is also known once any of its links is inked. links: a is needed by b (b needs a); ink is the trigger that inks the link: grows:<ground>:<plant> (that plant seen growing on that ground; plants on grass-painted ground count as growing in soil), seen:<page> (that page known), seenOn:<page>:<key> (that page known and that presence on the island), here:<key> (that presence on the island), mossOnRock (moss seen on painted rock), or flag:<name> (a journal flag, such as frogs:settled). note: the line the journal writes the first time a link inks (links already true when the journal starts ink quietly). Shares a home with: the known things that need something this one needs, worked out from the links (always-known nodes such as you aside). start: the node the Web opens on before any page has been shown. trailMax: how many recent taps the trail at the top keeps. shelfCols: tiles in a shelf row (six fit a row on a 375 px phone). groups: the focus card's three headings. unknown: how a thing not yet seen shows (label on chips and tiles; line on the card; hint, which names the known things it needs so it hints without telling). status: the card's line for a found thing, one seen on the island, and one not yet seen. ties: the small strip on each journal page.
